meta.scope: Philippines Batch 9 — environment/climate (NDC, GHG, forest), additional bilateral FTAs, population projections, and further densification.

candidates.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and climate-policy framework
candidates.publisher: Government of the Philippines / Climate Change Commission related
candidates.description: Philippine NDC under the Paris Agreement, targeting substantial GHG reduction relative to business-as-usual. Continuously cited in energy, transport, agriculture and LULUCF policy discussions.

candidates.title: Greenhouse gas inventory and emissions statistics
candidates.description: National GHG inventory results by sector (energy dominant; LULUCF as net sink). Provides the empirical base for NDC tracking.

candidates.title: Forest cover and forestry sector statistics
candidates.publisher: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) / PSA related
candidates.description: Land classification, forest cover, production/protection forest, and related forestry production and management statistics. Forests are treated as a net carbon sink in the NDC.

candidates.title: Philippines–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (PJEPA)
candidates.publisher: Governments of the Philippines and Japan
candidates.description: Long-standing bilateral EPA with Japan (in force since 2008). Covers goods, services, investment and movement of natural persons; continuously relevant to electronics, automotive and labour flows.
candidates.notes: Foundational bilateral EPA node with Japan.

candidates.title: Philippines–Korea Free Trade Agreement (PH-ROK FTA)
candidates.publisher: Governments of the Philippines and Republic of Korea
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA that entered into force end-2024. Provides deeper preferential access than existing ASEAN-Korea and RCEP schedules in priority products and includes economic-cooperation chapters.

candidates.title: Philippines–EFTA Free Trade Agreement
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA with the European Free Trade Association (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland), in force since 2018.

candidates.title: Population projections
candidates.description: Official population projections (recently to 2035, with national total approaching ~124 million). Provides the forward demographic frame for planning, labour and social-protection analysis.

candidates.title: Philippine FTA / EPA network overview
candidates.publisher: Department of Trade and Industry / derived
candidates.description: System-level view of the Philippines’ active free-trade and economic-partnership agreements (ASEAN, RCEP, PJEPA, PH-ROK, PH-EFTA, etc.). Organises the individual treaty nodes.

candidates.title: Philippines climate–FTA–demography densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from climate, DTI and PSA sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding NDC framework, GHG inventory, forest/LULUCF statistics, PJEPA, PH-ROK FTA, PH-EFTA, population projections and overall FTA network into a coherent climate, trade-architecture and demographic layer.
